intro.title: Who is Hải Thích Đi?
intro.lead: Hải Thích Đi was born on our first steps up a mountain, where every journey is less about reaching a summit and more about getting past yourself.
intro.highlight: We believe everyone has a limit — but very few dare to step out and touch it.
intro.listIntro: Hải Thích Đi isn't about resort holidays. We create the real thing:
intro.outro: With seasoned leaders who know the terrain and put safety first, Hải Thích Đi walks every step with you — from the moment you doubt yourself to the moment you stand on the summit.

trekking.title: Push your real limits
trekking.intro: We don't run trips just so you can say you went. Hải Thích Đi picks routes with genuine difficulty, so you actually feel what going past your limit means.
bullets: Routes graded by level: beginner, intermediate, advanced.
Signature treks: Tà Xùa, Phu Sa Phìn, Fansipan, the Samu moss forest.
Leaders who know the terrain and handle real situations.
Pre-trip briefing on fitness, skills and personal gear.
Most people who thought they couldn't make it still reached the top.
trekking.outro: Not everyone starts out strong, but everyone comes back stronger.
trekking.imageAlt: Pushing past your limits with Hải Thích Đi

connection.title: From strangers to teammates
connection.intro: What makes Hải Thích Đi special isn't the trail — it's the people. You can come alone, but you're never alone on the journey.
bullets: 90% of our guests come solo and go home with new friends.
On the trail everyone shares water and food, and pulls each other through the hard parts.
After the tour, many groups stay in touch and book the next trip together.
Our rule: nobody gets left behind.
Real connection with highland communities, porters and local guides.
connection.outro: It's not just walking together — it's city people and highland people actually understanding each other.
connection.imageAlt: Connection between fellow trekkers on the trail

charity.title: Travel that leaves value behind
charity.intro: A complete trip isn't only about what you get — it's about what you leave in the places you pass through.
bullets: Gifts for highland children on selected journeys.
Local services first: porters, homestays, local food.
Leave no trace: no littering, and we collect rubbish along the trail.
Many groups choose to donate more after the trip.
charity.outro: Every step leaves a mark on the mountain — and value in the places you pass.
charity.imageAlt: The giving-back spirit of our treks

about.title: Trekking. Connection. Giving back.
about.lead: The Hải Thích Đi story is written in seas of cloud, night campfires and goodbye hugs in mountain villages.
story: I used to be just someone who loved the mountains and the forest — that feeling of filling your lungs with clean air and letting your mind drift with the clouds. Then it hit me: if I'm the only one who gets to see this, what a waste. How good would it be if more people came along?

That thought started my journey as a trek guide. To me, trekking isn't only walking rough trails — it's a journey that connects people. A place where you can forget deadlines, leave the noisy city behind, and there's nothing left but laughter around the fire, songs made up on the spot, and honest stories nobody had dared tell before.
And I believe the value of a trip isn't only in the scenery. Now and then we bring small gifts for the highland children — sweets, notebooks — just to share a little joy.

More importantly, these treks open up work and extra income for the villagers after a hard harvest. They become the porters quietly carrying our loads, the cooks, the patient guides — they don't just make the trip better, they leave us with gratitude and memories we can't forget.

💚 For me, a complete journey needs all three: trekking, connection and giving back. And I believe that if you travel with Hải Thích Đi, you won't just see nature at its grandest or feel your mind open up — you'll come home with a new view of people, of life, and maybe of yourself.
about.quote: “Every journey is a new thread between people.”
